from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party in the legal case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party (e.g., appellant, defendant, applicant)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., 上诉人，被告人，复议申请人)")

class CourtCost(BaseModel):
    """Court fees or fines associated with the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Fee or fine amount as written")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the cost")
    type: str | None = Field(description="Type of cost (e.g., 二审案件受理费，罚金)")

class Sentence(BaseModel):
    """A criminal sentence handed down to a defendant."""
    defendant: str | None = Field(description="Name of the defendant")
    crime: str | None = Field(description="Crime committed")
    term: str | None = Field(description="Prison term")
    fine: str | None = Field(description="Fine amount")
    other_punishments: str | None = Field(description="Other punishments like confiscation, probation")

class CourtRuling(BaseModel):
    """The specific ruling or order made in the document."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="Action taken (e.g., 驳回上诉，准许撤诉，维持原判，定罪)")
    details: str | None = Field(description="Specific details of the ruling")
    is_final: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is a final judgment (e.g., '终审裁定')")

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information from a single legal document."""
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    court_region: str | None = Field(description="City or region of the court")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the court if available")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., 民事，刑事，执行)")
    instance_level: str | None = Field(description="Instance level (e.g., 一审，二审，执行)")
    rulings: list[CourtRuling] = Field(description="Rulings made in this document")
    sentences: list[Sentence] = Field(description="Criminal sentences if applicable")
    court_costs: list[CourtCost] = Field(description="Court costs/fines if applicable")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
